columns.name: matrix_id
columns.description: Stable row key derived from row type, source context and deterministic order.

columns.name: claim_type
columns.description: NUMERIC_ASSERTION, SCIENTIFIC_ASSERTION, METHOD_OR_SCOPE_ASSERTION, FIGURE_PANEL, TABLE_OBJECT, TABLE_CELL, or REVIEWER_QUESTION.

columns.name: source_document
columns.description: Source path relative to repository root, or included table source path.

columns.name: source_location
columns.description: TeX line (`L#`) or reviewer-ledger row.

columns.name: source_object_id
columns.description: Line, panel, table row/cell, or reviewer claim identifier.

columns.name: assertion_or_panel
columns.description: Section heading, panel, cell descriptor, or reviewer prompt descriptor.

columns.name: exact_source_quote_or_value
columns.description: Exact TeX segment, caption/table cell, registry content, or reviewer boundary text.

columns.name: numeric_tokens
columns.description: Numeric tokens extracted from the source text; not recalculated.

columns.name: referenced_labels
columns.description: Explicit LaTeX refs or source ledger location.

columns.name: sql_item_id
columns.description: Matched `rev1_results_index.item_id`, when direct label resolution succeeds.

columns.name: sql_panel
columns.description: Matched registry panel/label, where applicable.

columns.name: registry_content
columns.description: Exact registry content/status text used for this row.

columns.name: artifact_pointer
columns.description: Exact artifact/source/script pointers present in the registry or reviewer ledger; semicolon-separated if multiple.

columns.name: artifact_sha256
columns.description: Registry SHA-256 value(s), if recorded.

columns.name: generator_or_query
columns.description: Registered generator script or reviewer-ledger query pointer.

columns.name: registry_status
columns.description: Original registry/reviewer status value.

columns.name: reproduction_status
columns.description: Original registry reproduction result.

columns.name: lineage_status
columns.description: TRACEABLE, PARTIAL, or MISSING under this package’s conservative link semantics.

columns.name: gap_reason
columns.description: Reason the claim-to-artifact path is incomplete or absent.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of source file that supplied the text/value.

status_semantics.TRACEABLE: A figure/table registry row has a registered asset identity and passing reproduction/generator pointer, with no recorded manual-layout or known-issue exception. This is artifact lineage only, not scientific validation.
status_semantics.PARTIAL: An explicit artifact/registry route exists, but claim/cell-level binding, source identity, reproduction, known issue, manual layout, exception, or scope remains incomplete.
status_semantics.MISSING: No exact local claim-to-artifact pointer was resolved, or the reviewer ledger explicitly records a validation/provenance gap.
